The Host Stand Keeps Its Word
Two reservations seated 45 minutes late. A waitlist guest quoted three hours, told he was next, then told ninety more minutes, then texted after he left. Say the real number.
2
A Manager Goes to the Table
Two short ribs went out with no meat and a third plate was remade after everyone finished. No manager came and nothing came off the check. When a plate goes back, a manager goes to the table.
3
Repeat It Back, Then Ring It
A guest asked for no pepper flakes and got pepper flakes. A table’s whole appetizer order was forgotten. Bread ordered as a starter came out as dessert.
Engage Souls. Be 1% Better. Keep it Fun. 🌷
